headline: Last session: Markets look to crude oil trends and FII outflows as week opens Monday

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: FPI outflows exceeded ₹20,000 crore in September, driving cautious sentiment across Indian equities.
Crude oil price movement and West Asia developments are expected to influence market direction.
State Bank of India issued an advisory warning of potential disruptions due to a nationwide bank strike.
Brisk primary market activity continues as six companies prepare IPOs totaling ₹3,825 crore.
whatHappening: The stock market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, September 21.
India's exports to core BRICS nations rose 34% to reach $19.9 billion so far in FY27.
Traders are tracking GIFT Nifty, Nikkei, Kospi, and Taiwan indices for early opening signals.
Analysts have highlighted select recommendations including Acme Solar and Medanta for upcoming trades.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, September 21. Recent sessions have been marked by heavy foreign institutional investor selloffs exceeding ₹20,000 crore in September. Investors are now focused on crude oil trends, primary market IPO activity, and global cues for direction.
